chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbade ʿasīb al-faḥl, and it is the fee for mating.

key_terms.الضِّرَابِ: mating or covering by the male animal
key_terms.الْفَحْلِ: the male breeding animal or stallion
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.عَسِيبِ: the stud fee or compensation taken for breeding

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about charging a fee for the mating of a stallion?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم prohibited taking payment for ʿasīb al-faḥl, meaning the fee charged for the mating of a male animal. It reflects a legal ruling concerning unlawful forms of earnings and falls within discussions of livelihood and financial law.
